title: Reducedness and dominance for generic restrictions of smooth covers
statement: Let S be an integral scheme, c:C → S smooth, and q:Cη → Spec K, j:Cη → C a cartesian generic fibre, with K the function field of S. For any etale πX:X → C and its cartesian restriction πXη:Xη → Cη with comparison ψX:Xη → X, X is reduced and ψX is dominant. Neither finiteness, normality, nor connectedness is required. The empty case is included.

proof.text: The composite πX ≫ c is smooth. On affine neighborhoods U of the base and V in its inverse image, Γ(S,U) is a domain because U is nonempty and S is integral. A smooth A-algebra B is flat, so Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_injective embeds B in Frac(A) ⊗[A] B. This base change is smooth over the fraction field and hence reduced by [lem-sc-smooth-algebra-reduced-field]. Therefore B is reduced. Transport reducedness to V and its stalks through the affine isomorphism and the open immersion, and apply the stalkwise reducedness criterion.

The range of S.fromSpecStalk at its generic point contains that point, by fromSpecStalk_closedPoint, and is dense because the generic singleton is dense. The composite πX ≫ c is open: smoothness gives flatness and local finite presentation, and Mathlib UniversallyOpen.of_flat (Tag 01UA) applies. The preimage of the dense range is dense by Dense.preimage. Scheme.Pullback.range_fst identifies it with the image of the first projection of the canonical pullback. Paste hX with hCη.flip to identify Xη with this pullback; transport dominance along hp.isoPullback. Every step is valid for an empty X.

proof_origin.place: Tags 033B and 01UA; Tag 056T for the smooth algebra over a field input
proof_origin.note: Formal proof replaces the general reduced-base argument by injection into smooth fraction-field base change; density uses openness, Dense.preimage, and Mathlib pullback range.

theorem genericFibre_cover_reduced_and_dominant {S C : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral S]
    (c : C ⟶ S) [Smooth c]
    {Cη : Scheme.{u}} (q : Cη ⟶ Spec S.functionField) (j : Cη ⟶ C)
    (hCη : IsPullback q j (S.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint S)) c)
    {X Xη : Scheme.{u}} (πX : X ⟶ C) [Etale πX]
    (πXη : Xη ⟶ Cη) (ψX : Xη ⟶ X)
    (hX : IsPullback ψX πXη πX j) : IsReduced X ∧ IsDominant ψX
